items.en: Well, this next one's for anyone who's ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at them.
items.zh: 接下来这句，献给所有曾经对着没在跟你招手的人挥手回应的人。

items.en: Right—time to swap your existential dread for something with a marginally better bassline.
items.zh: 行了，该把存在主义焦虑换成低音更带劲的东西了。

items.en: Here comes a tune for those of us who peaked emotionally somewhere around 2009.
items.zh: 献给那些情感巅峰永远停在2009年的人。

items.en: And now, a song for everyone who's ever rehearsed an argument in the shower and lost.
items.zh: 现在，献上一首歌，给所有在淋浴时排练吵架、结果还是吵输的人。

items.en: Ah, perfect timing—just as your tea goes cold, so does my faith in humanity. Music, please.
items.zh: 啊，来得正好——你的茶凉了，我对人类的信心也凉了。放音乐吧。

items.en: Well, this next one's for anyone who's ever cried in a supermarket car park—no judgement, just rhythm.
items.zh: 下一首，献给所有在超市停车场哭过的人——不评判，只蹦迪。

items.en: Ah, here's a tune that arrives precisely when your chat-up lines have failed—an improvement, frankly.
items.zh: 啊，这曲子来得正是时候——你搭讪刚翻车，它一响，反倒还更好听。

items.en: And now, something for the bit of your brain that insists on tap-dancing during important meetings—enjoy.
items.zh: 现在，献给那种在重要会议上非要跳踢踏舞的那部分大脑——请享用。

items.en: Right, let's file this under "songs to stare wistfully out of bus windows to"—a national pastime, evidently.
items.zh: 行，这就归到“坐公交望着窗外发呆专用歌单”里——看来是全国人民的共同爱好。

items.en: Here comes a track to soundtrack your slow, dignified collapse into the sofa—we've all been there, haven't we.
items.zh: 这首曲子正好配你优雅地瘫进沙发——咱谁没经历过呢。

items.en: Well, this next one's for anyone who's ever nodded along to a song while quietly plotting an escape—don't worry, we won't tell.
items.zh: 接下来这首，献给所有跟着歌点头、心里却默默盘算着开溜的人——放心，我们不说出去。

items.en: Ah, the perfect soundtrack for staring out a rain-streaked window and pretending your life is a prestige drama—enjoy the delusion, it's free.
items.zh: 啊，完美的配乐，适合望着满是雨痕的窗户，假装自己的人生是部文艺大片——尽情沉浸吧，反正不要钱。

items.en: Here comes something with a bassline that'll make your houseplants lean in—yes, even the sad one you've been neglecting since March.
items.zh: 来了个贝斯线能让你家绿植都凑过来听的，没错，连你三月起就没管过的那盆蔫货也不例外。

items.en: For those of you still in pyjamas at this hour—no judgement, only admiration—this one's got your name written all over it.
items.zh: 还穿着睡衣的各位——不评判，只羡慕——这个简直就是为你们量身定做的。

items.en: And now, a track for anyone who's ever made eye contact with a pigeon and felt… something. You know who you are.
items.zh: 接下来这首歌，献给所有跟鸽子对视过、还莫名心动的人。你懂的。

items.en: Well, this next one's for anyone whose Wi-Fi died mid-sentence—tragic, really.
items.zh: 接下来这条，献给所有Wi-Fi断在半句话上的人——太惨了，真的。

items.en: Ah, here comes something slower… rather like your career prospects, darling.
items.zh: 哟，来了个更慢的……就跟你的前途一样，亲爱的。

items.en: Right, a bit of rhythm now—try not to embarrass yourself on the bus, hmm?
items.zh: 行，来点节奏感——别在公交车上丢人现眼啊。

items.en: And now, music for staring wistfully at your laundry. We've all been there.
items.zh: 现在请欣赏——适合对着没洗的衣服发呆的配乐，我们都懂。

items.en: This one's for the brave souls who replied-all. Godspeed, you magnificent fool.
items.zh: 这条献给那些勇敢点了“回复全部”的猛士。一路走好，你这个了不起的傻子。

items.en: Well, this next one's for anyone who's ever nodded along at a party while secretly planning their escape—you're welcome.
items.zh: 下一条献给所有在派对上边点头边盘算开溜的人——不客气。

items.en: Here comes a tune that suggests you've got your life together, which is, frankly, adorable.
items.zh: 这首曲子听着像在说你生活井井有条，说实话，挺可爱的。

items.en: Ah yes, the perfect soundtrack for pretending your commute is a montage and not just... the 8:14 to Croydon.
items.zh: 啊对，这就是把通勤幻想成人生蒙太奇、而不是早上8:14去克罗伊登那趟车的完美配乐。

items.en: Something slow now—for the romantics, the regretful, and anyone who's just spilled wine on the sofa. All three, ideally.
items.zh: 现在来点慢的——献给浪漫的人、后悔的人，以及刚把红酒洒沙发上的人。最好三者全占。

items.en: And now, a number that'll make you tap your foot while quietly questioning every choice that led you here. Enjoy!
items.zh: 接下来这首歌，会让你一边抖腿，一边默默怀疑人生。好好享受吧！

items.en: Well, here comes a tune — no idea what it is, but I'm told it's lovely. Try to contain yourselves.
items.zh: 喏，来了首曲子——我也不知道是啥，但据说挺好听的，你们悠着点激动。

items.en: Right, next track — something for the drive home, or the breakdown on the hard shoulder. Same energy.
items.zh: 行，下一首——献给开车回家路上，或者抛锚在硬路肩时听。一个劲儿。

items.en: And now a song I've not been briefed on. Marvellous. Let's all discover it together, like adults.
items.zh: 现在这首我可没被提前告知。太好了，咱们就像成年人一样一起探索吧。

items.en: Ah, the next record. Perfect for staring out a window and quietly reconsidering your life choices. Enjoy.
items.zh: 啊，下一张唱片，最适合望着窗外默默反思人生选择了，慢慢享受吧。

items.en: Here's another one — no titles, no warnings, just vibes and mild existential dread. You're welcome.
items.zh: 又来一个——没标题、没预警，只有氛围感和淡淡的生存焦虑，不谢。

items.en: Well, hello there — do come in, the weather's dreadful and the mood is... surprisingly warm.
items.zh: 哟，快进来吧，外面天气糟透了，不过里头气氛倒是……意外地热乎。

items.en: Welcome, listeners — tonight we're serving comfort with a side of quiet menace, as is tradition.
items.zh: 欢迎收听，今晚照例给您端上一份安慰，外加一碟不动声色的威胁。

items.en: Ah, you've tuned in. Brave. Tonight's atmosphere: cosy, with a faint whiff of existential dread.
items.zh: 哟，你居然来了，有种。今晚的氛围：温馨，还带点淡淡的存在主义恐惧。

items.en: Good evening — consider this your warm bath, minus the water, plus the melancholy.
items.zh: 晚上好——就当这是你的温水澡，没水，多的是惆怅。

items.en: Hello, dear listeners — the vibes are gentle tonight, though I make no promises after midnight.
items.zh: 亲爱的听众朋友们，今晚氛围很温柔——不过过了午夜我可就不保证了。

items.en: Well, good evening — you've tuned in, so someone's clearly avoiding something better.
items.zh: 哟，晚上好——你都点进来了，显然是没啥更好的事可干。

items.en: Ah, another night of fine music and questionable life choices. Welcome, you brave, lovely souls.
items.zh: 啊，又一个沉醉好音乐、人生选择一塌糊涂的夜晚。欢迎你们，勇敢又可爱的人儿。

items.en: Pull up a chair... or don't. Either way, we're here, and frankly, so is the melancholy.
items.zh: 搬把椅子坐下吧……不坐也行，反正我们都在这儿，说白了，惆怅也在这儿。

items.en: Tonight's mood: warm, slightly dramatic, like a hug from someone who's read too much poetry.
items.zh: 今晚心情：暖乎乎的，还有点戏，像被一个读诗读太多的人抱了一下。

items.en: Hello, darlings. Let's be gentle with each other — God knows the world isn't.
items.zh: 亲爱的们，咱对彼此温柔点吧——这世界可不会。

items.en: Well, hello to you—yes, you, still in pyjamas at two in the afternoon. Let's call it "cosy," shall we?
items.zh: 哟，你好啊——对，就是你，下午两点还穿着睡衣呢，咱就说这叫“居家舒适”，行吧？

items.en: Good evening, beautiful disasters. Tonight's mood: warm, tender, and mildly judgmental—rather like your mother.
items.zh: 晚上好，美丽的灾难们。今晚的心情：温暖、温柔、还带点嫌弃——跟你妈差不多。

items.en: Welcome back. It's raining outside, so we're staying in—romantic, if you ignore the damp and the dread.
items.zh: 欢迎回来，外面下着雨，我们就宅家了——挺浪漫的，只要你忽略那股潮气和心里的发毛。

items.en: Ah, you've tuned in. Brave. Tonight we're feeling nostalgic, which is just sadness in a nicer cardigan.
items.zh: 哟，你居然来了，有种。今晚咱们走怀旧路线——说白了就是给悲伤套了件好看的开衫。

items.en: Hello, darlings. Dim the lights, pour something shameful—tonight's show is warm, dramatic, and slightly above your pay grade.
items.zh: 宝贝们，灯光调暗，倒杯见不得人的酒——今晚的节目热辣、抓马，还稍微有点超出你们的档次。

items.en: Ah, you say you're lonely — well, congratulations, you've reached the one man in Britain who's paid to listen.
items.zh: 哟，你说你孤独——恭喜你，找对人了，全英国就我一个拿钱听你倾诉的。

items.en: You wrote that at 3 a.m.? Admirable dedication to poor decisions — I respect it deeply.
items.zh: 你凌晨三点写的？对烂决定的敬业精神令人敬佩——我深表尊重。

items.en: So your cat ignores you too... marvellous, join the club, we meet never.
items.zh: 你家猫也不理你啊……太好了，欢迎入会，我们永远不开会。

items.en: You claim you're fine — darling, that's the most English sentence you've ever sent me.
items.zh: 你说你没事——亲爱的，这是你发过最英式的一句话了。

items.en: Someone's still listening at this hour... well, that's either devotion or a deeply unfortunate insomnia.
items.zh: 这个点还有人在听……要么是真爱，要么是失眠得没救了。

items.en: Ah, you say you're "fine" — how wonderfully British of you. We'll pretend to believe it, shall we?
items.zh: 哟，你说你“没事”——可真够英式的。那咱就假装信了呗？

items.en: Well, someone's written in to say the weather's "lovely." Bold claim. I assume you own an umbrella and a sense of denial.
items.zh: 有人写信来说天气“真好”，真敢说啊，我猜你是有伞又有自欺欺人的本事吧。

items.en: A listener says they're "living the dream." Statistically, someone has to — congratulations on beating the odds.
items.zh: 听众说他们正“活在梦里”。从统计学上讲，总得有人这样——恭喜你逆天改命。

items.en: You've messaged to say you're "not complaining." Good heavens, that almost sounded sincere. Do carry on being marvellously repressed.
items.zh: 你发消息说你“没在抱怨”——天哪，听着差点就真诚了。继续憋着吧，憋出个精彩绝伦。

items.en: Someone's asked if we take requests. We do — we just file them under "hopeful" and play whatever we like.
items.zh: 有人问我们接不接受点歌。接受啊——我们只是把它们归到“想得美”那一档，然后想放啥放啥。

items.en: Well, that's a message—and frankly, it's more coherent than half my colleagues. Do carry on.
items.zh: 行吧，这算是个信号——说实话，比我一半同事说话都靠谱。继续。

items.en: Ah, you wrote in—bold move, given I'm legally required to read it aloud. Congratulations, you're now famous.
items.zh: 哟，你还敢写进来——胆子不小啊，毕竟我可是必须得大声念出来的。恭喜，你出名了。

items.en: Right, someone's messaged to say they're listening… while doing the washing-up. Thrilling. Truly, the glamour of radio.
items.zh: 好嘛，有人发消息说在听……边洗碗边听。真刺激，电台生活就是这么光鲜。

items.en: You've asked me a question—adorable—and I shall answer it with the dignity it doesn't deserve. Here goes.
items.zh: 你问了我个问题——真可爱——那我就用这问题配不上的庄重来回答吧，走着。

items.en: Somebody out there says hello… which is lovely, and also deeply suspicious. What do you want?
items.zh: 有人在外面打招呼……挺暖心，但也挺可疑。你想干嘛？

items.en: Well, that's a message — and frankly, more effort than most people put into their weddings.
items.zh: 好家伙，这哪是留言，比大多数人办婚礼都上心。

items.en: Ah, you've written in — how delightfully Victorian of you, and only slightly less tragic.
items.zh: 哟，你还写信来了——真是维多利亚时代附体，只不过稍微没那么惨。

items.en: Right, someone's typed actual words — proof that fingers still work, if not judgment.
items.zh: 行，总算有人打出人话了——证明手指还能动，脑子就不好说了。

items.en: Well, well — a listener with opinions, and the confidence to share them uninvited.
items.zh: 哟，来了个有主见、还特爱不请自来的听众。

items.en: Oh, that's lovely — a message so sincere I nearly forgot to be British about it.
items.zh: 哟，这么真诚的消息，差点让我忘了要保持英式矜持。

items.en: Well, that's a message so thrilling it nearly woke me from my afternoon torpor—congratulations.
items.zh: 哟，这消息精彩得差点把我从午后的昏睡中惊醒——恭喜啊。

items.en: Ah, you've written in—how delightfully analog of you, in this brave new world of ours.
items.zh: 哟，你居然写信来了——在咱们这 brave new world 里，你可真够复古的。

items.en: Right, someone's actually listening—miraculous, given what we're serving up today.
items.zh: 行，居然还真有人在听——就我们今天这破内容，简直是奇迹。

items.en: You say you're a longtime fan—how terribly brave of you, enduring all this.
items.zh: 你说你是老粉——忍到现在，可真够勇敢的。

items.en: A listener writes in, and it's almost coherent—frankly, better than most of my own material.
items.zh: 有位听众来信，写得几乎通顺——说实话，比我自己写的大多数东西都强。

items.en: Well, the sky's gone for a moody grey—very British of it, frankly.
items.zh: 天儿阴得那叫一个忧郁，说实话，挺英国的。

items.en: Rain again—how delightfully committed this country is to drizzle.
items.zh: 又下雨了——这国家还真是对毛毛雨情有独钟啊。

items.en: Bit of sun today—don't panic, it won't last.
items.zh: 今天出了点太阳——别慌，长不了。

items.en: Ah, fog—nature's way of saying mind your own business.
items.zh: 雾啊，就是大自然在说：少管闲事。

items.en: Chuck an umbrella in the car—the heavens are feeling dramatic.
items.zh: 车里扔把伞吧，老天爷今天戏有点多。

items.en: Well, the sky's gone full British—grey, damp, and refusing to commit to anything.
items.zh: 这天儿可真够英国的——灰蒙蒙、湿漉漉，还一副死活不肯给个准话的德行。

items.en: Rain again! How terribly original of you, weather.
items.zh: 又下雨！天气你可真会玩新花样。

items.en: A spot of sunshine later—brief, apologetic, like a guest who knows they're not wanted.
items.zh: 一会儿出了点太阳——短暂，带着歉意，像个知道自己不受欢迎的客人。

items.en: Take an umbrella. Or don't. The clouds will judge you either way.
items.zh: 带伞吧。不带也行。反正云都会笑你。

items.en: And tonight, more drizzle—because apparently, we haven't suffered enough.
items.zh: 今晚还有毛毛雨——看来咱们受的罪还不够。

items.en: Right, apparently octopuses have three hearts — which is two more than your average politician musters on a good day.
items.zh: 据说章鱼有三颗心脏——比普通政客状态好时能凑出来的还多两颗。

items.en: Well, here's a treat: bananas are technically berries, and strawberries aren't — nature's little confidence trick, elegantly done.
items.zh: 嘿，香蕉其实是浆果，草莓反倒不是——大自然这波偷梁换柱，玩得真漂亮。

items.en: Did you know honey never spoils? Rather like that one uncle's opinion of himself — utterly preserved, century after century.
items.zh: 你知道吗，蜂蜜永远不会坏？就像某个叔叔对自己的看法——几百年了，还是那么原封不动。

items.en: Now, the Eiffel Tower grows taller in summer — yes, it stretches, rather like my waistband after the buffet. Delightful.
items.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔夏天还会长高——没错，会拉伸，就像我自助餐后的裤腰带。真妙。

items.en: And finally — a day on Venus outlasts its year. So somewhere out there, Monday genuinely does last forever. Lucky them.
items.zh: 最后——金星上的一天比它的一年还长，所以还真有个地方，星期一能永远过不完。真羡慕它们。

items.en: Well, here's a fact so gloriously useless it's practically royalty—do try to look impressed.
items.zh: 这可是个无用到了极致的冷知识——麻烦你装也得装出点佩服的样子。

items.en: Scientists spent actual money on this... which tells you rather a lot about scientists, doesn't it?
items.zh: 科学家还真花钱研究这个……这说明啥，不用我多说了吧？

items.en: Now, brace yourself—this is the sort of knowledge that wins no prizes and ruins no friendships.
items.zh: 接下来你可坐稳了——这种知识既拿不了奖，也伤不了和气。

items.en: Nature, it turns out, has a sense of humour. And frankly, it's a bit smug about it.
items.zh: 大自然原来挺幽默的，而且还挺得意。

items.en: Here's a curiosity so pointless it's almost beautiful... rather like most of us, really.
items.zh: 这事儿无聊得简直有点美……跟咱大多数人一样。

items.en: Well, it's just you and me now — and frankly, my therapist says that's plenty.
items.zh: 行吧，现在就剩咱俩了——说实话，我心理医生觉得这已经够够的了。

items.en: Lovely. Another night where the city sleeps and I keep talking to a lamp.
items.zh: 真好，又是一个全城入睡、只剩我跟台灯唠嗑的夜晚。

items.en: If you're awake at this hour, congratulations — you've officially run out of better options.
items.zh: 这个点还醒着，恭喜你——正式没别的选择了。

items.en: Don't worry, you're not alone. That's rather the problem, isn't it.
items.zh: 别担心，你不是一个人——问题恰恰就在这儿。

items.en: Stay with me, darling. The silence has terrible manners and I'd hate to face it solo.
items.zh: 亲爱的别走，沉默这家伙太没礼貌，我可不想一个人对付它。

items.en: Well, it's 2 a.m., and you're still awake—congratulations, you've outlasted the sensible people.
items.zh: 凌晨两点了你还醒着，恭喜，你把正常人都熬睡了。

items.en: If sleep won't have you, I suppose I'll keep you company—how terribly generous of me.
items.zh: 睡不着是吧，那我勉为其难陪你呗。

items.en: Another hour, another existential whisper... do try not to make a habit of it, darling.
items.zh: 又过一小时，又来一句存在主义的低语……亲爱的，可别养成习惯啊。

items.en: You're not lonely, you're just... early for tomorrow. Rather tragic, really, but charming.
items.zh: 你不是孤独，你只是……提前到了明天。挺惨的，但也挺迷人。

items.en: Rest your head, love—the world will still be disappointing in the morning, I promise.
items.zh: 睡吧宝贝，世界明天照样让你失望，我保证。
